text:
sara_cs: FYI customer VelociCare reported a session token "drift" that causes requests to be attributed to wrong user after ~20m idle. They provided a repro and logs, see below.

nate_support: Repro steps from customer (copied):
1) Start a chat, send a message.
2) Wait ~22 minutes idle.
3) Send another message, it returns previous user's context.
4) Happens intermittently, ~2/10 sessions.

sara_cs: Attached log snippet from their private instance: 
```
[2026-03-10T14:12:03Z] session_id=abc123 user_id=vc_user_17 token=tok_9a3 valid=true
[2026-03-10T14:34:25Z] session_id=abc123 user_id=vc_user_17 token=tok_9a3 valid=false reason=stale_cache
[2026-03-10T14:34:25Z] session_id=abc123 user_id=vc_user_42 token=tok_b7c applied_from_cache=true
```

sara_cs: Customer says they saw user_id swap only after idle. They use Redwood Private v1.9.2 with default session affinity.

jess_pm: Thanks — we need to triage severity and whether this needs hotfix. Is this data-leak potential?

manny_eng: @jess_pm can you confirm: when they say "session token" do they mean our session-resume token in the prefix header or an app-level cookie?

nate_support: They confirmed it's our resume token header (x-rw-resume-token) — present in request, same token value but server returned different user metadata.

alex_se: Possible cause: KV cache eviction collision where keys are derived from truncated token fingerprint and collision occurs across tenants. We changed fingerprint salt in 1.9.0 but rollout was partial.

manny_eng: Can you paste exact request/response headers? Even obfuscated.

nate_support: Customer redacted but provided this header trace:
```
POST /v1/chat HTTP/1.1
Host: private.redwood.local
x-rw-resume-token: tok_9a3
x-tenant: veloci-care
Authorization: Bearer redacted
```
Response had body with user_id vc_user_42 and conversation pointer to other user.

manny_eng: Ok assigning to eng for investigation. Severity: P1? It's cross-tenant user attribution risk for Private. Recommend P0 if confirmed.

jess_pm: We should block Dedicated/Private 1.9.x -> 1.9.3 rollouts until we confirm. Also want acceptance criteria for a fix: 1) no token collisions under test harness 2) regression tests for resume-token hashing 3) patch with migration or config to revert salt.

sara_cs: Customer asked for ETA for fix and whether they should rotate tokens now. They also asked if logs could be sanitized for PII.

manny_eng: Short-term mitigation: add server-side verification bound to tenant ID stored with token, reject if mismatch. That should be small and can be backported as 1.9.3-rc. If token binding absent we return 403 rather than silently reusing session.

alex_se: I'll prototype the tenant-bound check and a synthetic collision test. ETA: 48h for POC.

jess_pm: Product asks: include rollout gate for Private installs and a feature flag to enable strict binding. Also add a migration note to release notes.

nate_support: I've opened internal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RI-3581 (customer: VelociCare). Linking customer's support case SC-9987.

manny_eng: Created draft PR and added unit tests for token fingerprint length and tenant binding. CI failing on one flake. @deploy-bot did a dry-run deploy to staging-priv.

deploy-bot: dry-run deploy completed: staging-priv -> ok, integration tests: 147 passed, 1 flaky (cache-ttl test).

alex_se: Flaky test seems unrelated. Reproducer script added to repo: tools/repro/ri-3581/collision_test.sh — use 10k randomized tokens across 100 tenants to look for collisions.

jess_pm: Prioritization: This goes to P0 for Private customers, automatic backport to supported 1.x branches. For Hosted customers, low incidence, schedule in next sprint but no emergency.

sara_cs: Customer notified: we will push a hotfix to private customers and recommend rotating tokens as precaution. They asked for weekly updates.

manny_eng: Next steps: 1) finish PR and get review 2) create hotfix release 3) coordinate with offerings team for private rollout notes 4) add regression test to nightly.

nate_support: Adding timeline to ticket: POC 2d, PR + review 3d, hotfix release 5d. I'll update SC-9987 and loop in account team.

jess_pm: Thanks team. Assigning owner: @manny_eng. Leaving this thread open for status updates. :white_check_mark:
